hero.title: Third Plane builds AI workforces for insurance.
hero.lead: Placement Desk takes on defined placement work across the systems and carrier channels your brokerage already uses.
hero.body: Send Placement Desk a submission or renewal. It works the markets and returns the quotes with a record of what it did.

tasks.task: Submission received by email: Sample Bakery LLC, BOP
Account information structured from the ACORD and loss runs

Quote returned through carrier API: Sample Carrier Co.

problem.title: You can’t hire your way out of the bottleneck.
problem.body: Accounts that were remarketed every few years are now worked every year, across more markets. More submissions. More follow-up. More work to place the same business.

points.title: Skilled capacity is finite
points.body: More submissions compete for the same limited producer and account manager time.

points.title: Another tool is not more capacity
points.body: New systems still need someone to learn them, manage them and use them.

points.title: Hiring preserves the constraint
points.body: Hiring adds capacity one person at a time while placement demand keeps growing.

points.title: The Real Cost
points.body: Markets never get shopped, quotes arrive late, renewals slip, and your team lacks the capacity to pursue new business.

approach.title: Most AI gives your people another tool. Third Plane builds it into your organization.
approach.body: Give someone an AI tool and they still own the work. Third Plane assigns defined work to an AI workforce and returns the finished outcome to your people for review.

models.note: The employee runs the tool, reviews the output and still owns the work.
The business assigns the work. The AI workforce executes it across your systems. Your people review the outcome and make the decisions.

desk.title: Send the work to the Placement Desk. Your team gets the quotes back.
desk.body: A dedicated placement function that takes new business and renewals from submission through returned quotes.

showcase.title: Two minutes on what changes when the work moves to a desk.
